description: Saves a Gmail draft in the firm's configured shared mailbox. Optional thread_id replies in that thread. Does not send. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

confirm.description: false or omitted returns a preview; true applies the change identified by preview_id.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A retry with the same key returns the first result without a second write. Defaults to preview_id.

is_html.description: Body is HTML. Defaults to plain text.

message_id.description: Gmail message id from search_shared_mailbox or get_shared_mailbox_thread.

preview_id.description: preview_id is the id returned by this tool's preview call. Required when confirm is true.

thread_id.description: Gmail thread id from search_shared_mailbox or get_shared_mailbox_thread.

name: draft_shared_mailbox_email
title: Draft shared mailbox email
